name: closing claim over a citation card and mascot mark
looks: A bold two-line claim about being found by AI tools and search settles over a small citation-style card referencing the platform that made it possible, with the mascot mark appearing last, small and centred, as the final hold.
build: wordmark-assemble's settle stage for the closing claim (fade and rise on one spring, the second line in the accent colour); the citation card and mark arrive a beat behind on their own shorter springs.
sound: A quiet resolving chord as the mark settles.
prompt: Close on a bold two-line claim about being discovered through AI answers or search, its key phrase in the accent colour, with a small citation-style proof card and the brand mark settling in beneath it a beat later. Keep the whole close calm and confident rather than busy.
